name: AI Zombie Trend: The Zombie Love Story With Your Partner or Pet
blurb: The AI zombie trend is a short love story: your partner or pet has turned into a zombie, you aim a pistol through tears, lower it and hug them anyway, then the clip cuts to a happy memory of you both.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 480p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: a cinematic zombie love story with the same camera angles, cuts, timing, light, color grade and film grain. The ONLY change: the survivor with the pistol is now the person in [Image 1], and the partner is the person in [Image 2] in every shot: the zombie in the house and the healthy partner in every throwback shot. No one from the video stays: [Video 1] gives no face, hair color or skin tone.
Copy each exact face in EVERY shot: face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair, and any beard, moustache or glasses as in the photo. The survivor wears the video's olive parka. In the house the partner is the person in [Image 2] in zombie makeup (grey cracked skin, dark veins, milky white eyes, torn dirty clothes). Shots 8 to 12 are a throwback, a warm golden memory of a good day: the partner has the face, hair color, hair length and skin tone of [Image 2], healthy and happy.
1. 0 to 1.4 s: close-up, the survivor aims the pistol, crying.
2. 1.4 to 2.2 s: wide, the survivor aims by the window.
3. 2.2 to 3.1 s: close-up, the zombie partner snarls.
4. 3.1 to 5.6 s: close-up, the survivor cries, the eyes close.
5. 5.6 to 6.1 s: close-up, the zombie partner screams.
6. 6.1 to 6.5 s: close-up, the survivor, eyes closed.
7. 6.5 to 6.75 s: wide, the zombie partner lunges at the survivor to bite.
8. 6.75 to 8 s: hard cut to the throwback, a golden field on a sunny day: the two hug and fall into the tall grass.
9. 8 to 9 s: close-up, the partner from [Image 2] laughs, the survivor's hand on the cheek.
10. 9 to 10.7 s: close-up, the survivor smiles in the grass.
11. 10.7 to 12.3 s: from behind, the two run hand in hand.
12. 12.3 to 15 s: close-up at sunset, the survivor kisses the head of the partner from [Image 2].
No shot is fired. No blood, no gore. No text, no watermark. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

Use the two uploaded images as the base. The person in the first image is the survivor. The animal in the second image is their pet, now a zombie. Keep the person's face, facial features, hair and body shape exactly the same as in their photo. Keep the animal's breed, size, face shape, fur color, ear shape and markings exactly the same as in its photo, so it is clearly the same pet. Do not blend the person and the animal. A still from a real zombie apocalypse film, inside a dim, abandoned farmhouse kitchen in daytime: dusty floor, an overturned chair, peeling walls, cold blue-grey daylight through dirty windows, floating dust. On the left, in the foreground, the survivor stands in three-quarter view facing right, in a dusty, worn version of their own outfit, and holds a wooden baseball bat raised in both shaking hands. The survivor's eyes are wet and red, one tear runs down one cheek, the lips are pressed together: they cannot do it. The survivor's face is clearly their own, not twisted by crying. On the right, a few steps away in the open doorway, the pet stands on all four legs facing the survivor: the same animal, now a zombie, with dull, matted, patchy fur, grey skin showing through, clouded milky-white eyes and a low, sad stance. Its face is still clearly the same pet. The survivor is shown from the knees up, the pet is shown whole, both faces clear and in focus. Muted teal and grey color grade, natural film grain, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, not CGI. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person and one animal, no blood, no gore, no text, no logos.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.0 Mini, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: A cinematic, emotional scene from a zombie apocalypse film, in two shots. Keep the person's face, hair and clothes and the pet's breed, fur color and face exactly as in the image. Shot 1: in the dim abandoned kitchen, the survivor holds the baseball bat raised with shaking hands, with tears in the eyes. The zombie pet in the doorway stops, tilts its head and looks at the survivor as if it remembers them, and its tail moves once. The survivor slowly lowers the bat, lets it drop to the floor, kneels down and opens their arms. The pet limps forward into their arms, and the survivor hugs it tightly with quiet tears, eyes open, the face still visible to the camera. Shot 2, a hard cut for the last seconds: a sunny green backyard at golden hour, the same person and the same pet, healthy again with clean, shiny fur; the pet runs into the person's arms, wags its tail and licks their face while the person laughs. Audio: an original slow, sad piano melody with soft strings and quiet breathing that turns warm and hopeful at the cut. No dialogue, no lyrics, no blood, no gore, no text, no logos.
